spec.description: PostgreSQL replication monitoring using PostgreSQL data source

spec.title: Inactive repl. slots
spec.description: Inactive slots cause WAL accumulation on the primary and autovacuum inefficiencies. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, sum((data->>'non_active_int')::int) FROM replication_slots WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication_slots where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Active repl. slots
spec.description: Number of active replication slots. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, count(*) filter (where data->>'non_active_int' = '0') FROM replication_slots WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication_slots where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Active replicas
spec.description: Currently connected replicas (visible on primaries).

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, count(*) FROM replication WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Active sync replicas
spec.description: Currently connected synchronous replicas (sync or quorum). Visible on primaries.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, count(*) filter (where data->>'is_sync_int' = '1') FROM replication WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Slot max. restart_lsn lag
spec.description: Maximum restart_lsn lag across all slots; translates to retained WAL size on the primary. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, max((data->>'restart_lsn_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication_slots WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication_slots where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Max. write lag
spec.description: Maximum write lag across connected replicas. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, max((data->>'write_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Max. flush lag
spec.description: Maximum flush lag across connected replicas. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, max((data->>'flush_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Max. replay lag
spec.description: Maximum replay lag across connected replicas. Based on last 5m data.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, max((data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication WHERE time in (select max(time) from replication where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.title: Database roles
spec.description: Database role of each monitored instance.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, dbname AS metric, max((data->>'in_recovery_int')::int) AS value FROM wal WHERE time in (select max(time) from wal where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY dbname

spec.title: Replication slot restart_lsn lag (primary extra WAL size)
spec.description: Per-slot restart_lsn lag; WAL the primary must retain for each slot.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' slot=' || (tag_data->>'slot_name'), max((data->>'restart_lsn_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication_slots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Repl. slot XMIN age (in transactions)
spec.description: Oldest transaction each slot needs the database to retain; blocks VACUUM cleanup.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' slot=' || (tag_data->>'slot_name'), avg((data->>'xmin_age_tx')::int8) FROM replication_slots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Replication flush lag
spec.description: Per-replica flush lag, based on pg_stat_replication. Visible on primaries with connected replicas.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), concat_ws(' ', dbname, tag_data->>'application_name', tag_data->>'client_info'), avg((data->>'flush_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Replication replay lag
spec.description: Per-replica replay lag, based on pg_stat_replication. Visible on primaries with connected replicas.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), concat_ws(' ', dbname, tag_data->>'application_name', tag_data->>'client_info'), avg((data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8) FROM replication WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: WAL timeline
spec.description: WAL timeline progression. A jump indicates a promotion/failover.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, max((data->>'timeline')::int) FROM wal WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: WAL location (bytes)
spec.description: Absolute WAL write/replay position.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, max((data->>'xlog_location_b')::int8) FROM wal WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: WAL generation rate
spec.description: WAL bytes generated per second, averaged over the aggregation interval.

spec.rawSql:
select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  dbname,
  avg((l - l_lag) / extract(epoch from time - time_lag))
from (
  select
    (data->>'xlog_location_b')::numeric as l,
    lag((data->>'xlog_location_b')::numeric) over w as l_lag,
    time,
    lag(time) over w as time_lag,
    dbname
  from wal
  where dbname in ($dbname) and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (partition by dbname order by time)
) x
where time > time_lag and l > l_lag
group by 1, 2
order by 1

spec.title: WAL files overview
spec.description: WAL file count and total WAL directory size.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' - WAL file count', max((data->>'wal_file_count')::int8) FROM wal_size WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' - WAL total size', max((data->>'wal_size_b')::int8) FROM wal_size WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Archive pending
spec.description: WAL files waiting to be archived (.ready files in archive_status).

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, avg((data->>'archiver_pending_count')::int8) FROM archiver_pending_count WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Pause state
spec.description: Recovery pause state. Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, dbname, CASE max(tag_data->>'pause_state') WHEN 'paused' THEN 2 WHEN 'pause requested' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM recovery WHERE time in (SELECT max(time) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY dbname) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY dbname

spec.title: Promote triggered
spec.description: Promotion has been triggered. Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 0 as time, dbname, max((data->>'promote_triggered_int')::int) FROM recovery WHERE time in (SELECT max(time) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY dbname) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY dbname

spec.title: Replay lag (bytes)
spec.description: Distance between replay_end_lsn and last_replayed_end_lsn. Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, max((data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Seconds since last replayed transaction
spec.description: Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, max((data->>'seconds_since_last_xact')::int8) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Seconds since current WAL chunk
spec.description: How long ago the startup process observed the latest WAL chunk. Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname, max((data->>'seconds_since_current_chunk')::int8) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Replay timelines
spec.description: last_replayed_tli vs replay_end_tli. A divergence indicates a timeline switch. Standby only.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' last_replayed_tli', max((data->>'last_replayed_tli')::int) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval), dbname || ' replay_end_tli', max((data->>'replay_end_tli')::int) FROM recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in (${recovery_dbname:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
